en: A black‑and‑white view over a busy central square with a large equestrian statue on a pedestal in the foreground, flower beds and pedestrians around it, and multi‑storey historic buildings with shops and awnings lining the streets. In the background are low hills and more city buildings. The reverse side shows handwritten Hungarian text, printed caption, address lines, and a Hungarian postage stamp.
